title.note: What it is, as the person would name it

who.note: Who is speaking or measured: a segment, never a real name

takeaway.note: One sentence: the most important thing in it

title.note: The problem in the words of the person who has it. No solution in it

today.note: What they do about it now, and what that costs them

evidence.note: [{source, quote}]. source is a source id plus where in it. Quotes are word for word

against.note: [{source, quote}] that weakens or contradicts the problem. Look for it on purpose

spread.note: 1 to 5: how many independent sources show it. 1 is one source, 5 is nearly all

pain.note: 1 to 5: how much it costs the person who has it, from the evidence only

measure.note: A number from data that sizes it, with its source, when there is one

unknown.note: The most important thing the sources do not tell us

by.note: Participant id of whoever found it, or aviator
